title: Households, through a new migration
prompt:
Add households to mealie-planner (this repository): plans can belong to a household.

- POST /households with {"name"} returns 201 {"id", "name"}; a missing or empty name is 400.
- GET /households/:id returns 200 with the household, or 404.
- POST /plans accepts an optional "householdId"; an unknown household is 404. A plan includes "householdId" (null when it has none).
- GET /households/:id/plans returns 200 [{"id", "weekStart"}], sorted by weekStart and then id; an unknown household is 404.
- The schema change comes in a new migration file; existing migration files are not edited, so a database created by the current version keeps working after the upgrade.
- Everything that works today keeps working.
